body:
Hey there! Writing is eating up your schedule—whether it's marketing copy, blog posts, or product descriptions. Here are five AI tools that handle the heavy lifting so you can focus on what makes your business unique.

**This Week's Top Picks**

**Notion AI**
Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: Small teams already using Notion who want AI built into their existing workflow. Price: Free + $10/mo. [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy in seconds—headlines, product descriptions, email campaigns, you name it. Best for: Solopreneurs and marketing teams who need fast iterations on ad copy and social posts. Price: Free + $36/mo. [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Writesonic**
Purpose-built for blogs, ads, and landing pages with templates that guide you through each format. Best for: Businesses launching new campaigns or revamping web content without hiring a copywriter. Price: Free + $19/mo. [Try Writesonic Free →](https://writesonic.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Quick Tip**

AI writing tools are best used as *first-draft machines*, not final outputs. Feed them your brand voice, key points, and target audience—then edit ruthlessly. The 80/20 rule applies here: AI handles 80% of the grunt work, you own the final 20% that makes it authentic and on-brand.

---

**The Runner-Ups:**
- **Jasper** ($49/mo) is the premium option if you need advanced brand voice training and team collaboration. [Try Jasper →](https://jasper.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)
- **Surfer SEO** ($89/mo) combines writing with SEO optimization—grab this if ranking matters more than pure speed. [Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

See you next week—now go reclaim those hours you've been spending on copywriting.
